title: The German commandant, the brewery and a ration card
summary: In an occupied Dutch/Belgian hotel he faced the arriving German command, who learned he had picked up German at Chris Hart's brewery in Washington and gave him a ration card.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now here's where I said well, if they are going to do me in, I'm going to get pretty I decided -- well, I got my suit on and so, I was -- what do you call the big hotel there -- the Metropole They are saying all this Dutch and, the Dutchland so, they said, all citizens stay in the house.

Queen Wilhamina had said -- because she had, the proclamation that she had surrendered -- she spoken French and all that and what she said, she said, please do not hurt my black population. Don't hurt my black population.

So, about two days, they come in there and they had them white suits on, every man was the same, they was soldering. They come in there, and they played "Deutschland uber Alles" (inaudible), and there was hailing and going on, and I was right -- when the big man come out of the car, I was right there so he could see me right there.
So, there wouldn't be no looking for me so I had -- he looked -- (inaudible).
He went on in, and the soldiers was there standing right on guard there. I said, well, so far so good.
So, a little later the waiter come back and says, "Would you like, would you have time to have some champagne with the Commandant?" I said, "Yes."
The gates -Sehr gut, danke. Very well, thank you.
He said -- "Har du komm siet?" -- and then he come -- passport -- (completion of paragraph in German.)

He says, "Where did you learn German?" He says, "Sit down" I said, "I come from Washington -- I have forgotten so much, but I learned it as a child. My mother worked for a brewery," and he said, "What's the name of the brewery and I said, "The Hart's Brewery, Chris Hart's brewery." He said, "Yes? Hummm." And he had his, you know, his bodyguards and everything there, so he said, sit down, and we had a good talk and he says, "Well, you know, we are going to make a new order." I says, I see there's some type of order here and this dude, he says, well, now, I'll tell you what I'll do for you I'm going to give you a ration card.
